wfe_name_required: Give the workflow a name before saving.
wfe_check_failed: The drawing could not be checked: %1$s
wfe_rerun_hint: A new run starts here, reusing what the earlier steps said in this run.
wfe_condition_path_hint: A value the run can read: input, steps.<id>.output or trigger.<field>.
wfe_condition_raw_hint: The form cannot split this condition into parts; edit it as text.
wfe_condition_routes_hint: Yes follows the success connections; no follows the failure ones.
wfe_delay_hint: Up to an hour. A longer wait belongs in a schedule.
wfe_notify_to: Goes to the inbox of whoever runs the workflow.
wfe_approval_who: Anyone who can answer approvals in this profile approves or denies it — here, in the inbox, or from the pending bar.
wfe_approval_required: Ask for approval before this step runs
wfe_issue_edge_from_unknown: This connection starts at a step that does not exist.
wfe_issue_edge_to_unknown: This connection ends at a step that does not exist.
wfe_issue_delay_out_of_range: The wait must be 0 to %1$s seconds.
wfe_issue_template_root_unknown: It reads %1$s, but a step can only read input, trigger or steps.
wfe_issue_template_step_unknown: It reads %1$s, but there is no such step.
wfe_issue_workflow_empty: The workflow has no steps yet.
wfe_issue_no_start: Every step has a step before it, so the workflow has no starting point.
wfe_issue_many_starts: %1$s steps have nothing before them; they all start together.
wfe_confirm_delete: Delete “%1$s”? Its runs and its schedules go with it.
wfe_no_steps: No steps yet. Add one below.
